990201.name: Orvalho Dairy Cooperative Milk Recording
990201.description:
Dataset: Orvalho Dairy Cooperative Milk Recording.

Monthly milk recording run in 2032 by the fictional Orvalho dairy cooperative to rank cows for breeding and feeding decisions. A technician weighs the milk of each cow at one milking with a certified meter and takes a sample analysed at the cooperative laboratory; body weight comes from the walk-over scale and feed intake from the herd's feeding robot. Each row is one cow on one test day.

Columns:
- cow_age_months: age of the cow, in months (typical range 26.4 to 82.3).
- days_in_milk: days since the cow last calved, in days (typical range 18 to 289).
- body_weight_kg: body weight, in kg (typical range 520 to 722).
- milk_kg_day: milk yield of the test day, in kg per day (typical range 22 to 51.1).
- fat_pct: milk fat content, in % (typical range 2.74 to 4.55).
- protein_pct: milk protein content, in % (typical range 2.4 to 3.41).
- somatic_cells_k_ml: somatic cell count of the milk, an udder-health indicator, in thousand cells per mL (typical range 39 to 673).
- dry_matter_intake_kg: dry matter eaten in the day, in kg (typical range 17.5 to 29.8).

Known relationships: Yield rises in the first two months after calving and then declines; older cows give more milk; fat content falls as yield rises and protein follows fat; somatic cells rise with age and late in lactation; heavier and higher-yielding cows eat more.

990202.name: Serra Alta Wind Farm Turbine Records
990202.description:
Dataset: Serra Alta Wind Farm Turbine Records.

Ten-minute averages exported in 2031 from the control system of the fictional Serra Alta wind farm for a performance audit. Wind speed comes from the nacelle anemometer, power and rotor speed from the converter, and temperatures and vibration from the condition-monitoring sensors. Each row is one turbine in one ten-minute interval.

Columns:
- wind_speed_m_s: wind speed at hub height, in m/s (typical range 2.25 to 14.2).
- ambient_temp_c: outside air temperature, in degrees Celsius (typical range 0.7 to 22.3).
- air_density_kg_m3: air density computed from temperature and pressure, in kg/m3 (typical range 1.19 to 1.29).
- active_power_kw: electrical power delivered, in kW (rated power 2,300 kW) (typical range 0 to 2.3e+03).
- rotor_speed_rpm: rotor speed, in revolutions per minute (typical range 8.21 to 16).
- blade_pitch_deg: blade pitch angle, in degrees (typical range -0.5 to 5.2).
- gearbox_oil_temp_c: gearbox oil temperature, in degrees Celsius (typical range 40.5 to 73.9).
- nacelle_vibration_mm_s: vibration velocity measured in the nacelle, in mm/s (typical range 2.54 to 4.93).

Known relationships: Power follows an S-shaped curve of wind speed and levels off at the rated power; denser (colder) air gives slightly more power; rotor speed rises with wind up to about 12 m/s; the blades pitch only above that speed; gearbox oil heats with power and outside temperature; vibration rises with rotor speed and power.

990203.name: Trans-Planalto Freight Trip Ledger
990203.description:
Dataset: Trans-Planalto Freight Trip Ledger.

Trip ledger compiled in 2030 by the fictional Trans-Planalto trucking company to renegotiate contracts. Distance, driving hours and fuel come from the trucks' telematics units, load from the weighbridge ticket, delay from the customer's receiving log and revenue from the invoice. Each row is one completed trip.

Columns:
- trip_distance_km: distance driven on the trip, in km (typical range 87 to 828).
- load_tonnes: cargo weight, in tonnes (typical range 7.6 to 26.6).
- driver_experience_years: driver's years of professional driving (typical range 2.2 to 22.8).
- driving_hours: time spent driving, in hours (typical range 1.92 to 13.9).
- fuel_litres: diesel used on the trip, in litres (typical range 28 to 271).
- unloading_minutes: time spent unloading at the customers, in minutes (typical range 43 to 134).
- arrival_delay_min: arrival time minus the booked slot, in minutes (negative = early) (typical range -30 to 74).
- trip_revenue: amount invoiced for the trip, in currency units (typical range 387 to 1.7e+03).

Known relationships: Driving time and fuel grow with distance, and fuel also with the load; unloading takes longer on long trips and with heavy loads; delays grow with unloading time and are shorter for experienced drivers; revenue grows with distance and load.

990204.name: Casa Laguna Hotel Group Stays
990204.description:
Dataset: Casa Laguna Hotel Group Stays.

Stay records extracted in 2031 from the property-management system of the fictional Casa Laguna hotel group to study pricing. Booking data come from the reservation engine, spending on extras from the folio at check-out and the score from the post-stay survey. Each row is one completed reservation.

Columns:
- booking_lead_days: days between booking and arrival (typical range 5 to 136).
- home_distance_km: distance between the guest's home address and the hotel, in km (typical range 36 to 1.44e+03).
- room_size_m2: floor area of the room booked, in m2 (typical range 16.2 to 39.5).
- nightly_rate: average price per night, in currency units (typical range 71 to 162).
- extras_spend: spending on restaurant, spa and minibar during the stay, in currency units (typical range 9.2 to 136).
- stay_hours: time between check-in and check-out, in hours (typical range 14.4 to 104).
- review_score: score given in the post-stay survey, from 1 to 10 (typical range 5.5 to 8.9).
- guest_age_years: age of the main guest, in years (typical range 23 to 64).

Known relationships: Larger rooms cost more and get slightly better scores; bookings made far in advance get slightly lower rates; guests from farther away stay longer; extras spending grows with the length of stay and with the rate; expensive stays get slightly lower scores.

990205.name: Colmeia Viva Apiary Sensor Network
990205.description:
Dataset: Colmeia Viva Apiary Sensor Network.

Daily summaries from the sensor network installed in 2032 by the fictional Colmeia Viva beekeepers' association. Each hive has a scale, a brood-chamber thermometer and an entrance bee counter; colony strength and mites are assessed in the monthly inspection closest to the day. Each row is one hive on one day.

Columns:
- outside_temp_c: mean outside temperature of the day, in degrees Celsius (typical range 5.7 to 29.7).
- outside_humidity_pct: mean outside relative humidity, in % (typical range 41 to 85).
- colony_frames_k_bees: estimated adult bee population, in thousands of bees (typical range 20.5 to 49).
- brood_temp_c: temperature in the brood chamber, in degrees Celsius (typical range 33.1 to 35.6).
- forager_trips_hour: bees leaving the entrance per hour of daylight (typical range 0 to 717).
- hive_weight_kg: weight of the hive, in kg (typical range 27.6 to 49.6).
- daily_weight_gain_kg: change in hive weight over the day, in kg (nectar intake minus consumption) (typical range -0.291 to 2.87).
- mites_per_100_bees: varroa mites counted per 100 bees in the inspection (typical range 1.1 to 12.1).

Known relationships: Colonies are larger in warm weather; strong colonies keep the brood near 34-35 degrees even in cold or hot weather; forager traffic grows with colony size and warmth; heavier hives belong to larger colonies; daily weight gain follows forager traffic; mite counts are higher in larger colonies.

990206.name: Picos Brancos Ski Resort Daily Operations
990206.description:
Dataset: Picos Brancos Ski Resort Daily Operations.

Operations log kept in 2031 by the fictional Picos Brancos ski resort to plan staffing. Snow and temperature come from the summit weather station, visits from the ticket gates, queue times from lift cameras and revenue from the ticketing system. Each row is one operating day.

Columns:
- snowfall_cm: fresh snow in the previous 24 hours, in cm (typical range 1 to 27).
- snow_base_cm: snow depth at the base station, in cm (typical range 69 to 202).
- summit_temp_c: mean summit temperature, in degrees Celsius (typical range -13 to 4.3).
- valley_hotel_occupancy_pct: occupancy of the hotels in the valley that night, in % (typical range 34 to 90.4).
- skier_visits: number of skier visits counted at the gates (typical range 1.69e+03 to 4.61e+03).
- mean_lift_queue_min: average waiting time at the lifts, in minutes (typical range 7.4 to 21.4).
- lift_hours_operated: total hours of lift operation in the day, summed over the lifts (typical range 83.8 to 136).
- ticket_revenue_k: ticket revenue of the day, in thousand currency units (typical range 98.4 to 282).

Known relationships: Busy valley hotels and fresh snow bring more visitors, and very cold or warm days fewer; queues grow with the number of visitors; very heavy snowfall cuts lift hours; the snow base grows with snowfall; revenue follows visits.

990207.name: Ponte Nova Used-Vehicle Auction House
990207.description:
Dataset: Ponte Nova Used-Vehicle Auction House.

Lot records published in 2030 by the fictional Ponte Nova vehicle auction house for dealers. Vehicle data come from the inspection report, bids and prices from the auction system and the time on the lot from the yard records. Each row is one vehicle sold at auction.

Columns:
- vehicle_age_years: age of the vehicle at the sale, in years (typical range 1.8 to 15.2).
- odometer_k_km: odometer reading, in thousand km (typical range 24 to 260).
- engine_litres: engine displacement, in litres (typical range 1.06 to 2.68).
- condition_grade: inspector's condition grade, from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent) (typical range 1.6 to 4.2).
- online_watchers: people following the lot in the online auction (typical range 60 to 109).
- reserve_price: seller's minimum acceptable price, in currency units (typical range 4.77e+03 to 2.19e+04).
- hammer_price: final sale price, in currency units (typical range 4.9e+03 to 2.59e+04).
- days_on_lot: days between arrival at the yard and the sale (typical range 0 to 29.8).

Known relationships: Older vehicles have more kilometres, worse condition and lower prices; bigger engines raise the price; vehicles in better condition attract more online watchers; the sale price follows the reserve and rises with the number of watchers; much-watched vehicles sell faster.

990208.name: Montes Claros Permanent Forest Plots
990208.description:
Dataset: Montes Claros Permanent Forest Plots.

Plot measurements from the 2031 cycle of the fictional Montes Claros forest inventory, used to estimate timber stocks. Field crews measure trunk diameters with tapes and heights with laser hypsometers; elevation and slope come from the plot GPS and the stand age from planting records. Each row is one plot.

Columns:
- elevation_m: plot elevation, in m (typical range 262 to 1.72e+03).
- slope_deg: terrain slope, in degrees (typical range 4.2 to 39.2).
- stand_age_years: age of the stand, in years (typical range 16 to 96).
- mean_dbh_cm: mean trunk diameter at breast height, in cm (typical range 10 to 52.1).
- dominant_height_m: height of the tallest trees, in m (typical range 11.3 to 29.3).
- trees_per_ha: number of trees per hectare (typical range 462 to 1.35e+03).
- basal_area_m2_ha: total cross-section area of the trunks, in m2 per hectare (typical range 10.6 to 128).
- litter_depth_cm: depth of the leaf litter layer, in cm (typical range 2.3 to 7.9).

Known relationships: Older stands have thicker and taller trees and fewer trees per hectare; trees are a little smaller at high elevation; height grows with diameter and levels off; basal area combines tree count and diameter; litter is deeper in older stands and thinner on steep slopes.

990209.name: Rio Manso Basin Gauging Network
990209.description:
Dataset: Rio Manso Basin Gauging Network.

Daily readings from the gauging network run in 2030 by the fictional Rio Manso basin agency for flood warning and water-quality reports. Stage comes from pressure sensors, discharge from the station rating curve, rainfall from the nearest rain gauge and the quality variables from multiparameter probes. Each row is one station on one day.

Columns:
- rain_24h_mm: rainfall over the catchment in the previous 24 hours, in mm (typical range 0.9 to 50.4).
- catchment_km2: area drained by the station, in km2 (typical range 77 to 2.18e+03).
- stage_m: water level at the station, in m (typical range 0.46 to 1.46).
- discharge_m3_s: river flow, in m3/s (typical range 0.73 to 16.8).
- turbidity_ntu: water turbidity, in NTU (typical range 3.1 to 29).
- water_temp_c: water temperature, in degrees Celsius (typical range 7.59 to 20.2).
- dissolved_oxygen_mg_l: dissolved oxygen, in mg/L (typical range 7.59 to 11).
- conductivity_us_cm: electrical conductivity of the water, in microsiemens per cm (typical range 97 to 317).

Known relationships: Water level rises with rain, more in large catchments; flow grows steeply with level and with catchment size; rain makes the water more turbid and dilutes it (lower conductivity); warmer and more turbid water holds less oxygen.

990210.name: Nuvem Sul Data Center Rack Telemetry
990210.description:
Dataset: Nuvem Sul Data Center Rack Telemetry.

Hourly rack telemetry exported in 2032 by the fictional Nuvem Sul colocation provider for a cooling study. Power comes from the rack power units, temperatures from front and rear sensors, utilization and memory errors from the servers' management controllers. Each row is one rack in one hour.

Columns:
- servers_in_rack: number of servers installed in the rack (typical range 9 to 40).
- cpu_utilization_pct: mean processor utilization of the rack, in % (typical range 21.2 to 80.8).
- inlet_temp_c: air temperature at the rack front, in degrees Celsius (typical range 18.8 to 25).
- rack_power_kw: electrical power drawn by the rack, in kW (typical range 3 to 15.3).
- outlet_temp_c: air temperature at the rack back, in degrees Celsius (typical range 25.3 to 44.4).
- fan_speed_pct: mean server fan speed, in % of maximum (typical range 25 to 73).
- corrected_memory_errors: memory errors corrected by the servers in the hour (typical range 0 to 12).
- site_pue: power usage effectiveness of the hall in that hour (typical range 1.11 to 1.25).

Known relationships: Power grows with the number of servers and their utilization; the outlet air is warmer than the inlet by an amount that grows with power; fans speed up as the outlet heats and as utilization rises; memory errors are more frequent in hot, crowded racks; the hall uses more overhead energy when the inlet air is warmer.

990211.name: Aeroporto Lagoa Seca Gate Turnarounds
990211.description:
Dataset: Aeroporto Lagoa Seca Gate Turnarounds.

Turnaround records collected in 2031 by the operations centre of the fictional Lagoa Seca airport to set ground-handling targets. Aircraft and passenger data come from the airline's departure control system, times from gate sensors and fuel from the fuelling company. Each row is one aircraft turnaround.

Columns:
- passengers: passengers on the departing flight (typical range 58 to 244).
- load_factor_pct: share of seats occupied, in % (typical range 57 to 95.8).
- checked_bags: number of checked bags loaded (typical range 45 to 211).
- inbound_delay_min: arrival delay of the incoming flight, in minutes (typical range -4 to 37).
- ground_crew_hours: staff-hours of ground handling assigned to the turnaround (typical range 1.89 to 6.79).
- turnaround_min: time from on-block to off-block, in minutes (typical range 21 to 48).
- departure_delay_min: departure delay, in minutes (typical range -10 to 25).
- fuel_uplift_kg: fuel loaded at the gate, in kg (typical range 3.08e+03 to 1.37e+04).

Known relationships: Bigger and fuller flights carry more bags and need longer turnarounds; more ground staff shortens the turnaround; departure delays inherit part of the inbound delay and grow with long turnarounds; bigger aircraft take more fuel.

990212.name: Torra Fina Specialty Roastery Batch Log
990212.description:
Dataset: Torra Fina Specialty Roastery Batch Log.

Batch log kept in 2030 by the fictional Torra Fina specialty coffee roastery for quality control. Temperatures and times come from the roaster's probes, bean moisture from a moisture meter, colour from a roast-colour analyser and the cupping score from the weekly tasting panel. Each row is one roast batch.

Columns:
- green_batch_kg: weight of green coffee charged, in kg (typical range 6.9 to 16.9).
- bean_moisture_pct: moisture of the green beans, in % (typical range 9.4 to 12.3).
- charge_temp_c: drum temperature when the beans are charged, in degrees Celsius (typical range 183 to 217).
- roast_minutes: total roast time, in minutes (typical range 9.1 to 12.5).
- drop_temp_c: bean temperature when the roast ends, in degrees Celsius (typical range 214 to 225).
- weight_loss_pct: weight lost during roasting, in % (typical range 10.9 to 14.6).
- agtron_color: roast colour reading (lower = darker) (typical range 70.2 to 84.5).
- cupping_score: score given by the tasting panel, from 0 to 100 (typical range 81.7 to 85.7).

Known relationships: Larger and wetter batches take longer to roast, and a hotter charge shortens the roast; long roasts end at higher temperatures; hotter drops lose more weight and give darker colours; the best scores come from medium colours.

990213.name: Costa Brava Norte Offshore Buoy Array
990213.description:
Dataset: Costa Brava Norte Offshore Buoy Array.

Hourly observations from the fictional Costa Brava Norte buoy array, published in 2031 for marine forecasting. Waves come from accelerometers, wind and air data from the buoy mast, and currents from an acoustic profiler; fetch is computed from the wind direction and the coastline. Each row is one buoy in one hour.

Columns:
- wind_speed_m_s: wind speed at 4 m above the sea, in m/s (typical range 2 to 15.3).
- fetch_km: open-water distance over which the wind blows, in km (typical range 38 to 548).
- significant_wave_m: significant wave height, in m (typical range 0.3 to 2.26).
- peak_period_s: period of the most energetic waves, in seconds (typical range 5.1 to 10.6).
- sea_level_pressure_hpa: air pressure at sea level, in hPa (typical range 996 to 1.03e+03).
- sea_surface_temp_c: sea surface temperature, in degrees Celsius (typical range 12 to 21.8).
- air_temp_c: air temperature, in degrees Celsius (typical range 10.4 to 21.7).
- surface_current_m_s: surface current speed, in m/s (typical range 0.16 to 0.71).

Known relationships: Waves grow with wind speed and with fetch; higher waves have longer periods; strong winds come with lower pressure; air temperature follows the sea temperature, a little cooler; currents strengthen with wind.

990214.name: Movimento Fitness Club Membership Panel
990214.description:
Dataset: Movimento Fitness Club Membership Panel.

Monthly membership panel assembled in 2032 by the fictional Movimento fitness club chain to reduce cancellations. Visits and session lengths come from the turnstiles, classes and training sessions from the booking app, fees from billing and satisfaction from a monthly in-app question. Each row is one member in one month.

Columns:
- member_age_years: age of the member, in years (typical range 16 to 56).
- tenure_months: months since the member joined (typical range 2.1 to 39.7).
- gym_hours_month: time spent in the club in the month, in hours (typical range 2.9 to 23.4).
- mean_session_min: average time spent per visit, in minutes (typical range 37 to 86).
- group_class_share_pct: share of the time in the club spent in group classes, in % (typical range 8 to 64.8).
- monthly_fee: fee paid in the month, in currency units (typical range 26.2 to 55.8).
- personal_training_spend: spending on personal training in the month, in currency units (typical range 0 to 200).
- satisfaction_0_10: answer to 'how satisfied are you with the club?', from 0 to 10 (typical range 5 to 10).

Known relationships: Long-standing members spend more time in the club and pay slightly lower fees; older members come a little less and stay shorter; members on higher fees spend more on personal training; members who spend more time in the club are more satisfied.

990215.name: Seguradora Atlas Motor Claims File
990215.description:
Dataset: Seguradora Atlas Motor Claims File.

Closed motor claims extracted in 2030 by the fictional Atlas insurance company for a reserving study. Driver and vehicle data come from the policy, impact speed from the crash recorder or the police report, costs from the assessors and dates from the claims system. Each row is one closed claim.

Columns:
- driver_age_years: age of the insured driver, in years (typical range 20 to 67).
- vehicle_value: market value of the vehicle, in currency units (typical range 7.5e+03 to 3.92e+04).
- impact_speed_kmh: estimated speed at impact, in km/h (typical range 11 to 76).
- vehicle_damage: assessed repair cost of the vehicle, in currency units (typical range 257 to 7.75e+03).
- medical_costs: medical costs of the people injured, in currency units (typical range 49 to 3.91e+03).
- days_to_report: days between the accident and the claim report (typical range 0.5 to 13.2).
- days_to_settle: days between the report and the settlement (typical range 4 to 26).
- amount_paid: total amount paid by the insurer, in currency units (typical range 0 to 8.74e+03).

Known relationships: Damage grows with impact speed and with the vehicle's value; medical costs rise steeply with speed; older drivers report a little later; large claims and late reports take longer to settle; the amount paid follows the total cost minus the deductible.

990216.name: Banco Horizonte Mortgage Applications
990216.description:
Dataset: Banco Horizonte Mortgage Applications.

Mortgage applications received in 2031 by the fictional Banco Horizonte, assembled for a fair-lending review. Income and job tenure come from verified documents, the credit score from the bureau, the home price from the purchase contract and the rate from the pricing engine. Each row is one application.

Columns:
- annual_income: verified annual income of the applicants, in currency units (typical range 3.09e+04 to 1.4e+05).
- credit_score: bureau credit score, from 300 to 850 (typical range 608 to 791).
- home_price: purchase price of the home, in currency units (typical range 1.05e+05 to 6.38e+05).
- down_payment_pct: down payment, in % of the price (typical range 3 to 31.9).
- loan_amount: requested loan, in currency units (typical range 8.6e+04 to 5.38e+05).
- debt_to_income_pct: monthly debt payments including the new loan, in % of monthly income (typical range 24.5 to 45).
- offered_rate_pct: annual interest rate offered, in % (typical range 6.85 to 8.61).
- job_tenure_years: years in the current job (typical range 1 to 16.2).

Known relationships: Higher earners have slightly better scores and buy more expensive homes; applicants with better scores put more money down; the loan is the price minus the down payment; larger loans relative to income raise the debt ratio; better scores get lower rates and higher debt ratios higher rates.

990217.name: Palco Aberto Live Music Venues
990217.description:
Dataset: Palco Aberto Live Music Venues.

Show records compiled in 2032 by the fictional Palco Aberto network of live-music venues to plan its calendar. Ticket data come from the ticketing platform, follower counts from the artists' streaming profiles, bar and merchandise sales from the point-of-sale system and sound levels from the venue meter. Each row is one show.

Columns:
- venue_capacity: maximum audience of the venue (typical range 560 to 7.99e+03).
- artist_followers: artist's followers on the main streaming platform (typical range 1.29e+04 to 6.29e+05).
- ticket_price: average ticket price, in currency units (typical range 16 to 79.5).
- tickets_sold: number of tickets sold (typical range 207 to 3.97e+03).
- days_on_sale: days between the start of sales and the show (typical range 10 to 120).
- bar_sales_k: bar sales during the show, in thousand currency units (typical range 2.55 to 57.9).
- merch_sales_k: merchandise sales, in thousand currency units (typical range 0.57 to 29.2).
- peak_sound_db: peak sound level measured at the mixing desk, in dB (typical range 93.5 to 104).

Known relationships: More popular artists charge more and fill a larger share of the venue; tickets sold are limited by capacity; bar and merchandise sales grow with the audience; bigger venues are slightly louder.

990218.name: Hemocentro Vale Verde Donor Sessions
990218.description:
Dataset: Hemocentro Vale Verde Donor Sessions.

Donation sessions recorded in 2031 by the fictional Vale Verde blood centre to review donor eligibility screening. Age and donation history come from the donor register, weight, pulse, blood pressure and haemoglobin from the screening station, and volume and time from the collection scale. Each row is one whole-blood donation.

Columns:
- donor_age_years: age of the donor, in years (typical range 22 to 63).
- body_weight_kg: body weight, in kg (typical range 54.2 to 95.5).
- hemoglobin_g_dl: haemoglobin measured before donation, in g/dL (typical range 12.3 to 16.2).
- years_since_first_donation: years since the donor's first donation (typical range 0.5 to 31.1).
- pulse_bpm: pulse before donation, in beats per minute (typical range 56 to 86).
- systolic_bp_mmhg: systolic blood pressure before donation, in mmHg (typical range 98 to 140).
- collected_ml: volume of blood collected, in mL (typical range 431 to 471).
- collection_minutes: time needed to collect the unit, in minutes (typical range 5.9 to 12).

Known relationships: Older donors have been donating for longer; experienced donors have slightly lower pulse; blood pressure rises with age and weight; collection is quicker for donors with higher haemoglobin and slower for those with a fast pulse; the collected volume is close to the 450 mL target.

990219.name: Cervejaria Três Pedras Fermentation Tanks
990219.description:
Dataset: Cervejaria Três Pedras Fermentation Tanks.

Fermentation records kept in 2030 by the fictional Três Pedras craft brewery to standardize its recipes. Gravities come from a digital density meter, temperatures from the tank controllers, yeast counts from the lab microscope and diacetyl and bitterness from the monthly lab panel. Each row is one fermentation batch.

Columns:
- original_gravity: specific gravity of the wort before fermentation (typical range 1.04 to 1.07).
- pitch_rate_m_cells_ml: yeast added, in million cells per mL (typical range 0.43 to 1.31).
- ferment_temp_c: fermentation temperature, in degrees Celsius (typical range 16.2 to 21.1).
- days_to_terminal: days until the gravity stopped falling (typical range 9 to 14.9).
- final_gravity: specific gravity at the end of fermentation (typical range 1.01 to 1.01).
- abv_pct: alcohol by volume, in % (typical range 4.03 to 7.59).
- diacetyl_mg_l: diacetyl (a buttery off-flavour) at packaging, in mg/L (typical range 0.012 to 0.053).
- bitterness_ibu: bitterness, in international bitterness units (typical range 14 to 54).

Known relationships: Stronger worts take longer to ferment, and warmer tanks and more yeast finish sooner; final gravity rises with the original gravity; alcohol is set by the drop from original to final gravity; diacetyl is higher in warm fermentations and falls with more days in the tank.

990220.name: Mineração Serra Dourada Haul Fleet
990220.description:
Dataset: Mineração Serra Dourada Haul Fleet.

Haul-cycle records collected in 2031 by the fleet management system of the fictional Serra Dourada open-pit mine. Payload comes from the trucks' on-board scales, distance and speed from GPS, fuel from the engine controller and tyre temperature from tyre sensors. Each row is one haul cycle.

Columns:
- payload_tonnes: material carried, in tonnes (typical range 170 to 251).
- ramp_grade_pct: average grade of the haul ramp, in % (typical range 4.6 to 11.3).
- haul_distance_km: one-way haul distance, in km (typical range 1.37 to 4.76).
- cycle_time_min: time for a full load-haul-dump-return cycle, in minutes (typical range 16.4 to 38.9).
- fuel_litres: diesel used in the cycle, in litres (typical range 4 to 16.1).
- tyre_temp_c: maximum tyre temperature, in degrees Celsius (typical range 67.7 to 81.9).
- shovel_queue_min: time waiting at the shovel, in minutes (typical range 0.4 to 10.2).
- mean_speed_kmh: average travel speed, in km/h (typical range 9.9 to 17.6).

Known relationships: Cycles are longer for longer and steeper hauls and heavier loads; fuel grows with distance, grade and payload; tyres run hotter with heavier loads and longer hauls; speed is the round trip divided by the travel time.

990221.name: Terminal Porto Azul Vessel Calls
990221.description:
Dataset: Terminal Porto Azul Vessel Calls.

Vessel-call records compiled in 2030 by the fictional Porto Azul container terminal for its annual productivity report. Vessel data come from the shipping line's booking, moves and crane hours from the terminal operating system, waiting times from the port authority and wind from the quay anemometer. Each row is one vessel call.

Columns:
- ship_capacity_teu: vessel capacity, in twenty-foot equivalent units (typical range 2.61e+03 to 1.55e+04).
- container_moves: containers loaded and unloaded (typical range 429 to 3.79e+03).
- crane_hours: total working hours of the quay cranes on the vessel (typical range 15.3 to 144).
- moves_per_crane_hour: average moves per crane per hour (typical range 21.5 to 34.8).
- berth_hours: time alongside the quay, in hours (typical range 7.79 to 29.1).
- anchorage_wait_hours: time waiting at anchor before berthing, in hours (typical range 5.1 to 32.6).
- wind_gust_m_s: maximum wind gust during the call, in m/s (typical range 1.9 to 14).
- reefer_moves: refrigerated containers handled (typical range 28 to 774).

Known relationships: Bigger ships exchange more containers and get more cranes; crane productivity falls slightly when many cranes work one ship; crane hours are the moves divided by productivity; time at berth is the crane hours shared among the cranes plus delays; bigger ships wait a little longer at anchor; refrigerated moves are a small share of all moves.

990222.name: Lumina Games Player Telemetry
990222.description:
Dataset: Lumina Games Player Telemetry.

Weekly player telemetry exported in 2032 by the fictional mobile-game studio Lumina Games to study retention. All variables come from the game's analytics events, except spending, which comes from the app store's payment reports. Each row is one active player in one week.

Columns:
- player_level: player's level in the game (typical range 6 to 66).
- days_since_install: days since the game was installed (typical range 12 to 190).
- mean_session_min: average session length, in minutes (typical range 10 to 72.4).
- playtime_hours_week: time played in the week, in hours (typical range 0.67 to 7.64).
- friend_list_size: number of friends in the player's friend list (typical range 6 to 40).
- spend_last_30d: in-game purchases in the last 30 days, in currency units (typical range 0 to 5.99).
- win_rate_pct: share of matches won, in % (typical range 33.3 to 59.3).
- median_ping_ms: median network latency, in milliseconds (typical range 21 to 78).

Known relationships: Higher-level players installed the game longer ago, play more hours, have larger friend lists and spend more; players with more friends also spend more; win rate rises a little with level.

990223.name: Linha Verde Commuter Rail Trips
990223.description:
Dataset: Linha Verde Commuter Rail Trips.

Trip records published in 2031 by the fictional Linha Verde commuter rail operator for a punctuality review. Boardings come from automatic passenger counters, delays and dwell times from the signalling system, energy from the train meters and temperature from the depot weather station. Each row is one train trip.

Columns:
- route_km: length of the route, in km (typical range 12.4 to 42.3).
- mean_stop_spacing_km: average distance between consecutive station stops, in km (typical range 1.88 to 4.11).
- boardings: passengers boarding along the trip (typical range 226 to 954).
- outside_temp_c: outside temperature, in degrees Celsius (typical range -1.71 to 25.6).
- mean_dwell_s: average time stopped at each station, in seconds (typical range 26 to 60).
- arrival_delay_min: delay at the final station, in minutes (typical range -0.1 to 8.71).
- peak_load_pct: maximum occupancy along the trip, in % of seated capacity (typical range 24 to 107).
- traction_kwh: traction energy used, in kWh (typical range 234 to 791).

Known relationships: Routes with closely spaced stations have more stops; crowded trains stop longer at stations; delays grow with crowding, long dwells on routes with many stops, and very hot or cold weather; occupancy follows boardings; energy grows with distance, passengers and stops.

990224.name: Recife das Tartarugas Reef Survey
990224.description:
Dataset: Recife das Tartarugas Reef Survey.

Underwater transect surveys made in 2030 by divers of the fictional Recife das Tartarugas marine park to monitor reef health. Cover is scored from photo quadrats, fish are counted along the transect, water temperature comes from dive computers and turbidity from a Secchi disc. Each row is one transect.

Columns:
- transect_depth_m: depth of the transect, in m (typical range 3.5 to 19.2).
- water_temp_c: water temperature, in degrees Celsius (typical range 26.4 to 29.6).
- secchi_turbidity_index: turbidity index derived from the Secchi disc reading (typical range 0.71 to 3.68).
- live_coral_cover_pct: seabed covered by live coral, in % (typical range 15.9 to 51.3).
- macroalgae_cover_pct: seabed covered by large algae, in % (typical range 6.59 to 37.2).
- fish_species_count: fish species recorded along the transect (typical range 25 to 56).
- fish_biomass_kg_ha: estimated fish biomass, in kg per hectare (typical range 358 to 1.21e+03).
- urchins_per_m2: sea urchins per m2 (typical range 0.3 to 4.65).

Known relationships: Coral cover is highest around 8 m and lower in warmer or more turbid water; algae take the space where coral is scarce and in turbid water; more coral supports more fish species and biomass; urchins are more abundant where algae are abundant.

990225.name: Estação Anilhadora Ponta do Vento
990225.description:
Dataset: Estação Anilhadora Ponta do Vento.

Capture records from the autumn 2031 migration season at the fictional Ponta do Vento bird-ringing station. Ringers measure each bird with rulers and callipers, weigh it on a digital scale and score its fat visually; time and temperature are logged at capture and stopover length comes from recaptures. Each row is one first capture of one bird.

Columns:
- wing_chord_mm: length of the folded wing, in mm (typical range 61.8 to 82).
- body_mass_g: body mass, in g (typical range 10.5 to 17.8).
- fat_reserve_g: estimated visible fat reserves, in g (typical range 0.62 to 2.76).
- tarsus_mm: length of the tarsus bone, in mm (typical range 16.4 to 22.4).
- capture_hour: hour of the capture, in decimal hours (typical range 5.13 to 11.8).
- air_temp_c: air temperature at capture, in degrees Celsius (typical range 2.6 to 16.5).
- day_of_year: day of the year of the capture (typical range 243 to 297).
- stopover_days: days between first and last capture at the station (typical range 0 to 8.5).

Known relationships: Bigger birds (longer wings and tarsus) are heavier; heavier birds carry more fat; air warms through the morning; birds with large fat reserves leave sooner.

990226.name: Geleira Branca Mass-Balance Stakes
990226.description:
Dataset: Geleira Branca Mass-Balance Stakes.

Stake measurements from the 2031 survey of the fictional Geleira Branca glacier, made for a climate monitoring programme. Glaciologists read ablation stakes and dig snow pits; temperature is interpolated from automatic weather stations and velocity from repeated GPS surveys of the stakes. Each row is one stake.

Columns:
- stake_elevation_m: elevation of the stake, in m (typical range 2.67e+03 to 3.85e+03).
- aspect_north_index: how much the slope faces north, from -1 (south) to 1 (north) (typical range -0.92 to 0.88).
- summer_mean_temp_c: mean summer air temperature at the stake, in degrees Celsius (typical range 0.39 to 8.28).
- winter_snow_m_we: winter snow accumulation, in m of water equivalent (typical range 0.67 to 2.31).
- debris_cover_cm: thickness of rock debris on the ice surface, in cm (typical range 0 to 20.1).
- summer_melt_m_we: summer melt, in m of water equivalent (typical range 0.23 to 5.35).
- annual_balance_m_we: net annual mass balance, in m of water equivalent (typical range -4.35 to 1.75).
- surface_velocity_m_yr: ice surface velocity, in m per year (typical range 15.2 to 50).

Known relationships: It is colder and snowier higher up; melt grows with summer temperature, is lower on north-facing slopes and under thick debris; the annual balance is winter snow minus summer melt; ice flows a little slower higher up.

990227.name: Elevadores Ascende Maintenance Records
990227.description:
Dataset: Elevadores Ascende Maintenance Records.

Monthly maintenance records assembled in 2032 by the fictional Ascende elevator-maintenance company to plan inspections. Trips, door cycles and waiting times come from the elevator controllers, faults and downtime from service tickets and vibration from the annual ride-quality test. Each row is one elevator in one month.

Columns:
- travel_height_m: vertical travel of the elevator, in m (typical range 15.5 to 85.3).
- installation_age_years: years since installation (typical range 1.6 to 33.5).
- trips_per_day: average trips per day (typical range 282 to 854).
- door_cycles_per_day: average door openings per day (typical range 583 to 1.82e+03).
- mean_wait_s: average passenger waiting time, in seconds (typical range 13.5 to 41.4).
- mean_days_between_faults: mean time between faults over the last year, in days (typical range 11 to 78.1).
- downtime_hours: hours out of service in the month (typical range 0.4 to 10.9).
- car_vibration_mg: ride vibration in the car, in milli-g (typical range 9.9 to 23.3).

Known relationships: Taller installations have more trips and longer waits; door cycles follow trips; older and busier elevators fault more often and are out of service longer; vibration rises with age.

990228.name: Museu do Litoral Visitor Counts
990228.description:
Dataset: Museu do Litoral Visitor Counts.

Daily visitor records kept in 2030 by the fictional Museu do Litoral to plan staffing and ventilation. Visitors are counted by door sensors, tours by the booking system, dwell time by ticket scans at entry and exit, sales by the shop register and CO2 by the gallery air sensors; weather comes from the city station. Each row is one opening day.

Columns:
- outside_temp_c: mean outside temperature, in degrees Celsius (typical range 3.78 to 31.1).
- rain_mm: rainfall during opening hours, in mm (typical range 0.2 to 11.3).
- city_hotel_occupancy_pct: occupancy of the city's hotels that day, in % (a proxy for tourism) (typical range 31.1 to 86.9).
- visitors: visitors counted at the doors (typical range 1.22e+03 to 3.86e+03).
- guided_tour_visitors: visitors in guided tours (typical range 47.9 to 640).
- mean_dwell_min: average time spent in the museum, in minutes (typical range 68 to 120).
- shop_sales_k: museum shop sales, in thousand currency units (typical range 4.23 to 20.6).
- gallery_co2_ppm: peak CO2 concentration in the main gallery, in ppm (typical range 654 to 1.11e+03).

Known relationships: Busy tourist days and rainy days bring more visitors and very hot or cold days fewer; tours are a small share of visitors; crowded days have slightly shorter visits; shop sales and gallery CO2 rise with the number of visitors.

990229.name: Tinturaria Arco-Íris Dye-House Batches
990229.description:
Dataset: Tinturaria Arco-Íris Dye-House Batches.

Batch records kept in 2031 by the fictional Arco-Íris textile dye house for its quality-control system. Weights come from the batch scale, temperatures and times from the dyeing-machine controller, exhaustion from the dye-bath spectrophotometer, colour difference from the lab spectrophotometer and water from the machine meter. Each row is one dye batch.

Columns:
- batch_kg: fabric weight in the batch, in kg (typical range 165 to 430).
- liquor_ratio: litres of dye bath per kg of fabric (typical range 5.4 to 10.6).
- dye_temp_c: dyeing temperature, in degrees Celsius (typical range 81 to 108).
- dye_minutes: dyeing time at temperature, in minutes (typical range 45 to 96).
- shade_depth_pct: dye applied, in % of fabric weight (typical range 0.41 to 3.51).
- dye_exhaustion_pct: share of the dye taken up by the fabric, in % (typical range 62.3 to 77.8).
- color_delta_e: colour difference from the approved standard (lower = better match) (typical range 0.64 to 2.48).
- water_m3: water used, in m3 (typical range 1.24 to 4.01).

Known relationships: Hotter dyeing runs shorter; uptake improves with temperature and time and worsens with more bath per kg; batches with poor uptake match the standard worse; water use is batch weight times the liquor ratio.

990230.name: Abrigo Quatro Patas Adoption Records
990230.description:
Dataset: Abrigo Quatro Patas Adoption Records.

Animal records exported in 2032 from the case-management system of the fictional Quatro Patas animal shelter to study adoption times. Age and weight come from the intake exam, page views and listing text from the adoption website, costs from veterinary invoices and the behaviour score from staff assessments. Each row is one adopted animal.

Columns:
- animal_age_years: estimated age of the animal, in years (typical range 0.4 to 8.5).
- weight_kg: body weight, in kg (typical range 5.2 to 36.2).
- days_in_shelter: days between intake and adoption (typical range 9 to 63).
- listing_page_views: views of the animal's adoption page (typical range 285 to 424).
- listing_text_words: length of the adoption listing text, in words (typical range 101 to 139).
- vet_costs: veterinary costs during the stay, in currency units (typical range 97.9 to 355).
- behaviour_score_1_5: staff behaviour assessment, from 1 to 5 (5 = very sociable) (typical range 2.14 to 4.76).
- adoption_fee: adoption fee charged, in currency units (typical range 60 to 212).

Known relationships: Older animals stay longer in the shelter, get fewer page views, cost more in veterinary care and are adopted for lower fees; animals that stay longer and have longer listings get more views; sociable animals carry higher fees.
